```bash
#!/bin/bash

# Date Formatter - Core Implementation

format_date() {
    local input_date="$1"
    local format_string="$2"
    
    # Check for empty input
    if [[ -z "$input_date" ]]; then
        echo "Empty input not allowed"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Parse input date and extract components
    local year month day
    
    # Try YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-M-D format
    if [[ "$input_date" =~ ^([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{1,2})-([0-9]{1,2})$ ]]; then
        year="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        month="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        day="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
    # Try YYYY/MM/DD or YYYY/M/D format
    elif [[ "$input_date" =~ ^([0-9]{4})/([0-9]{1,2})/([0-9]{1,2})$ ]]; then
        year="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        month="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        day="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
    # Try MM-DD-YYYY or M-D-YYYY format
    elif [[ "$input_date" =~ ^([0-9]{1,2})-([0-9]{1,2})-([0-9]{4})$ ]]; then
        month="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        day="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        year="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
    # Try MM/DD/YYYY or M/D/YYYY format
    elif [[ "$input_date" =~ ^([0-9]{1,2})/([0-9]{1,2})/([0-9]{4})$ ]]; then
        month="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        day="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        year="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
    else
        echo "Invalid date format"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Validate month
    if [[ $month -lt 1 || $month -gt 12 ]]; then
        echo "Invalid month"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Validate day
    if [[ $day -lt 1 || $day -gt 31 ]]; then
        echo "Invalid day"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Format output based on format string
    local output="$format_string"
    
    # Replace format tokens
    output="${output//%Y/$year}"
    output="${output//%y/${year: -2}}"
    output="${output//%m/$(printf "%02d" $month)}"
    output="${output//%d/$(printf "%02d" $day)}"
    
    # Month names
    local months=("" "January" "February" "March" "April" "May" "June" "July" "August" "September" "October" "November" "December")
    local short_months=("" "Jan" "Feb" "Mar" "Apr" "May" "Jun" "Jul" "Aug" "Sep" "Oct" "Nov" "Dec")
    
    output="${output//%B/${months[$month]}}"
    output="${output//%b/${short_months[$month]}}"
    
    echo "$output"
}
EOF
```
